name: org-standards
description: PeoplesHR product knowledge for every role. Ships the phx-product-context skill, which retrieves PeoplesHR module behaviour, known findings, design documents and user documentation from the four WeKnora knowledge bases (PeoplesHR Module Behaviour Brief, PeoplesHR Findings-Register, Product Development, PeoplesHR Academy) through the weknora-peopleshr-product-knowledge MCP server each person connects themselves, so developers doing solution engineering and Business Analysts writing a PRD or eliciting requirements start from grounded, cited context. In 6.0.0 it replaced phx-business-context, merged with the developer phx-product-context from dev-kit, and the plugin stopped declaring the weknora MCP server.
